text: 市场监管总局今天（29日）公布数据显示，上半年，全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户，同比增长7.0%。从投资区域看，出口大省、沿边省份外商投资企业增长“双轮驱动”。上半年，海南、山东、广东、江苏等出口大省新设外商投资企业增速分别为38.6%、15.2%、8.1%、6.8%；黑龙江、内蒙古、广西、吉林等沿边省份新设外商投资企业增速分别达到79.5%、29.1%、16.6%、12.0%。（央视新闻）
text_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation today (29th) released data showing that in the first half of the year, 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide, up 7.0% year-on-year. By investment region, growth in foreign-invested enterprises in major export provinces and border provinces showed a 'dual-engine' drive. In the first half, new foreign-invested enterprises in export-heavy provinces such as Hainan, Shandong, Guangdong, and Jiangsu grew 38.6%, 15.2%, 8.1%, and 6.8% respectively; in border provinces like Heilongjiang, Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, and Jilin, growth reached 79.5%, 29.1%, 16.6%, and 12.0% respectively. (CCTV News)
